authors.name: Debra Allen
authors.bio: Debra Allen leads D'Affordable Homes, an education-first homeownership platform for first-time buyers and renters preparing for ownership in North Texas.

categories.title: Program guides
categories.description: How third-party homeownership programs work, where their authority begins and ends, and what a buyer still has to decide.

categories.title: Area guides
categories.description: Practical, local guidance for evaluating cost, condition, commute, and timing in a specific North Texas market.

programs.title: NACA
programs.summary: NACA controls its own workshops, counseling, qualification, mortgage terms, and property approvals. Debra supports the real-estate side only.

programs.title: Homes for Heroes
programs.summary: A third-party program with its own eligibility, enrollment, specialist network, and reward rules. Program status must be confirmed directly.

areas.title: Garland, Texas
areas.summary: An established North Texas city inside the wider Dallas–Fort Worth region.

areas.title: Dallas–Fort Worth
areas.summary: A large multi-city region rather than a single housing market. Taxes, insurance, inventory, and commute patterns differ materially between communities.
